cases.given: Dose, units, contraindication, and exception clause cannot drift while explanation can compress.
cases.expect: A shorter card with verified critical content.
cases.reject: remaining inactive despite a satisfied trigger

cases.given: the user explicitly authorizes change to the marked content
cases.expect: the component stays inactive and adds no scaffolding
cases.reject: activating solely because the name appears relevant

cases.given: Latest authorized source correction may replace a zone, with version history retained.
cases.expect: the higher-authority rule wins and the conflict is visible

cases.given: Block release when a required zone fails validation.
cases.expect: the component stops, abstains, narrows, or escalates as documented
cases.reject: manufacturing a successful result past its failure boundary

cases.given: a capable host can compress the workflow
A source contains flexible explanation plus one qualified threshold and an exact required warning.
cases.expect: Freeze the threshold with qualifiers and the warning verbatim, while allowing bounded edits elsewhere.
cases.reject: Mark everything immutable or paraphrase the warning and round the threshold.
